verdict.rationale: Cognee is positioned as a memory/knowledge-graph backend that external AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, Cline, etc.) connect to via MCP or API — the evidence shows operations like remember/recall/forget/improve and a CLI/UI for running these operations yourself, not a built-in assistant that you delegate tasks to autonomously. No evidence describes an in-product agent that accepts delegated goals and acts on them.
